title: Problem
问题
html: Primary source: arXiv 2105.09938 and the official Hendrycks APPS repository; the paper appeared at NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks. The problem is rigorous evaluation of code generation beyond small function-completion tasks. APPS belongs here as an executable code benchmark, not as a reasoning trace dataset or a training recipe. The data object is a programming problem with natural-language specification, constraints, examples, candidate Python solution, and input/output tests. Its atlas value is the programmatic feedback contract: generated code is judged by running tests.

一手来源是 arXiv 2105.09938 和 Hendrycks 官方 APPS 仓库；论文发表于 NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks。它解决的问题是：代码生成评测不能只停在小型函数补全，而要覆盖更接近编程挑战的自然语言题面。收录边界是可执行代码 benchmark，不是推理轨迹数据集，也不是训练 recipe。数据对象包括题面、约束、样例、候选 Python 解法和输入/输出测试。atlas 价值在于程序化反馈契约：代码通过运行测试来判定。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: APPS contributes a large programming-challenge benchmark where language models must generate full Python programs from natural-language specifications. The mechanism is simple but strict: collect coding problems of varying difficulty, provide problem statements and tests, and score generated programs by execution. The closest comparisons are HumanEval/MBPP-style function tasks and competitive-programming datasets such as CodeContests. The direction label is executable benchmark surface: success is a test outcome, not a judge preference or prose similarity score.

核心贡献是一个大型 programming-challenge benchmark，要求模型从自然语言题面生成完整 Python 程序。机制并不复杂，但验收严格：收集不同难度的编程题，提供题面和测试，通过执行候选程序给分。最近参照是 HumanEval/MBPP 式函数题，以及 CodeContests 等竞赛编程数据。方向标签是 executable benchmark surface：成功信号来自测试结果，不来自偏好 judge 或文本相似度。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: a problem statement, constraints, examples or starter context, difficulty metadata, and hidden or released input/output tests.
  2. Pipeline: prompt the model to write a Python solution, execute the solution in the APPS evaluation harness, compare outputs with tests, and aggregate pass/fail statistics.
  3. Outputs: candidate programs, per-problem test outcomes, and benchmark-level accuracy/pass-rate metrics.
  4. Feedback contract: the verifier is the execution harness plus problem tests; failure can come from syntax error, runtime error, wrong output, timeout, or unsupported environment.
  5. Reproducibility notes: pin the APPS release, split, difficulty band, Python/runtime limits, prompt policy, sample count, and test visibility.

1. 输入：题面、约束、样例或 starter context、难度元数据，以及隐藏或已发布的输入/输出测试。
  2. 流程：提示模型生成 Python 解法；在 APPS evaluator 中执行；把程序输出与测试期望比较；最后汇总 pass/fail 指标。
  3. 输出：候选程序、逐题测试结果和 benchmark 级准确率/通过率。
  4. 反馈契约：verifier 是执行 harness 加测试用例；失败可能来自语法错误、运行时错误、输出错误、超时或环境不兼容。
  5. 复现边界：固定 APPS release、split、难度层级、Python/runtime 限制、prompt 策略、采样次数和测试可见性。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The arXiv abstract states that APPS contains 10,000 problems ranging from simple one-line solutions to substantial algorithmic challenges, and that models are evaluated by checking generated code on test cases. It reports that GPT-Neo-style models could pass about 20% of the test cases on introductory problems at the time. The decisive instance-level evidence is a candidate program's execution result on the relevant tests. Evidence boundaries include public-test leakage, timeout policy, Python dependency differences, sampling budget, and whether the metric is per-test or per-problem.

arXiv 摘要说明 APPS 包含 10,000 道题，跨度从一行解法到较复杂算法挑战，并通过测试用例检查生成代码。论文当时报告 GPT-Neo 类模型在 introductory 题目的测试用例上约能通过 20%。单条样本的决定性证据是候选程序在对应测试上的执行结果。证据边界包括公开测试泄漏、超时策略、Python 依赖差异、采样预算，以及指标到底是 per-test 还是 per-problem。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Before APPS, many code-generation evaluations were small, synthetic, or focused on short function completion. APPS changes the evaluation surface by using broad natural-language coding challenges with executable tests and difficulty bands. The direction signal is benchmark realism plus programmatic checking. What is not new: executing code against tests and collecting programming-contest tasks were established ideas. Reuse checks must inspect licensing, original problem provenance, split contamination, hidden-test availability, timeout rules, and whether public solutions or tests have entered model pretraining corpora.
APPS 之前，很多代码生成评测规模小、偏合成，或集中在短函数补全。APPS 的变化是用更广泛的自然语言编程挑战和可执行测试来定义评测面，并区分难度层级。方向信号是更真实的编程题加程序化验收。不是新的部分包括运行测试评估代码、收集编程竞赛题。复用前要检查 license、原始题目来源、split 污染、隐藏测试可用性、超时规则，以及公开解法/测试是否已进入模型预训练语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html: APPS correctness is only as strong as its tests and execution harness. Passing tests does not prove semantic equivalence for all inputs, and failing tests can reflect environment mismatch rather than reasoning failure. Public problem statements, solutions, and released tests are contamination risks for later models. The benchmark is evaluation-only unless a separate training-data audit is done. It should not be treated as measuring software engineering workflows, repository modification, or interactive debugging; it measures standalone program synthesis under the chosen prompt and runtime policy.

APPS 的正确性强度取决于测试和执行 harness。通过测试不证明对所有输入语义等价；失败也可能来自环境差异，而不一定是推理失败。公开题面、解法和 released tests 都是后续模型污染风险。除非另做训练数据审计，否则它只是 evaluation surface。不要把它当作软件工程 workflow、仓库修改或交互式调试能力评测；它测的是给定 prompt/runtime 策略下的独立程序生成。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use APPS as a canonical executable benchmark reference for coding-challenge competence. Preserve problem ID, split, difficulty, prompt text, constraints, visible examples, candidate code, language/runtime, timeout, test outcomes, and aggregation rule. For atlas curation it is useful as a baseline for programmatic-verifier feedback and as a warning that public code benchmarks need contamination controls. It can inform reward design only when the same execution contract and failure labels are retained.

APPS 可作为 coding-challenge competence 的经典可执行 benchmark 参考。复用时应保留 problem ID、split、难度、题面、约束、可见样例、候选代码、语言/runtime、超时、测试结果和聚合规则。对 atlas 来说，它是 programmatic-verifier feedback 的基线，也提醒公开代码 benchmark 必须做污染控制。只有保留同一执行契约和失败标签时，才适合拿来设计 reward。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Separate three levels: passing a visible sample, passing the APPS tests, and solving the full underlying programming problem. Aggregate pass rates hide which failure mode occurred. Read the evaluator and split details before comparing numbers across papers, because prompt format, sample count, and timeout can move results without changing the benchmark tasks.
要分清三个层级：通过可见样例、通过 APPS 测试、真正解决完整编程题。总体通过率会掩盖具体失败类型。跨论文比较分数前先看 evaluator 和 split 细节，因为 prompt 格式、采样次数和 timeout 会改变结果，即使题目本身没变。
